name: Daman and Diu
tagline: A tranquil haven by the Arabian Sea

topAttractions.name: Nagoa Beach
topAttractions.description: A picturesque beach with crystal-clear waters and powdery white sand

topAttractions.name: Diu Fort
topAttractions.description: A 16th-century Portuguese fort that now houses a museum and offers stunning views of the Arabian Sea

topAttractions.name: Jalandhar Beach
topAttractions.description: A scenic beach with a historic lighthouse and a tranquil atmosphere

bestTimeToVisit: October to March, when the weather is mild and pleasant
culturalFact: Daman and Diu have a significant Portuguese influence, with many historical buildings and landmarks still standing, including the 16th-century St. Jerome Fort in Daman.

hiddenGem.name: Chakratirth Beach
hiddenGem.description: A secluded beach in Diu with a tranquil atmosphere and stunning sunsets

relatedFestival: The Diu Festival, a three-day celebration of music, dance, and culture, held annually in December
passportTieIn: If you have stamps from Portugal or Goa, you'll feel right at home in Daman and Diu, with its rich Portuguese history and cultural influences!
